corpus.authored_by: hand-authored, hermetic, row-by-row reviewable (tests/eval/ask/generate_corpus.py) — the #9095 method (run it small and by hand first)
corpus.hash_scope: fixtures/*.json + gold/*.gold.json (a gold-only edit changes the hash and voids this pre-registration)

inconclusive: the corpus manifest does not verify (missing/extra/mismatched file, or corpus hash drift)
this pre-registration's corpus_hash does not match the corpus under test
this file names no cases or no classes (a protocol with no case or class list cannot certify a run)
the scored run does not cover exactly the pre-registered cases, or does not cover exactly the pre-registered classes (a subset run, or a run with a graded class stripped, is not this measurement)
the run's fixtures_hash does not match the scored corpus's (the run was over different fixtures than the gold grades)
the run's resolved reader spec, judge spec, judge pin, judge rubric hash, sampling seed flags, arms, or gate arm differ from this pre-registration
the metrics block disagrees with the per-case rows it summarises (a summary is not a result)
the run is a falsification probe (it measures the gate, not the product)
the scored corpus plants NO superseded claim, has NO verbatim case, or the raw arm committed no verbatim case (an empty measurement is not a green one)
any case failed to run in either arm (an unmeasured case is never a pass)
decision_rule.kind: paired within-run comparison + product gate; NO pre-set quality threshold
decision_rule.pass: the corpus verifies, the config matches this pre-registration, every case ran in both arms, and neither regression clause fired

per_category.mechanism_dependency: #2516 (seal per-category, type-stratified gates). Declared, not absorbed: this record fixes the row surface and the requirement that each class is legible; the enforcement mechanism is #2516's
rows: knowledge-update — the D8 gate: rendered_live / seen / n over the planted superseded claims, plus the current-state rate REPORTED (never thresholded)
verbatim — the no-regression half: raw.committed vs distilled.committed per case, with the regressed case ids listed
per_category.threshold: NONE is pre-set per class either. The knowledge-update rate is reported, the verbatim comparison is a regression, and neither needs an absolute to be read
per_category.verdict_per_class: each class is read against the clauses that APPLY to it (the D8 gate for knowledge-update, the paired comparison for verbatim). A class with no clause in this bar is reported as not graded, never as a pass, and on a run whose bar is `inconclusive` EVERY class reports `inconclusive` rather than a class green under an inconclusive headline; the per-class GATE MECHANISM (a verdict sealed per class) is #2516's and is not claimed to be implemented here

regression: D8: any superseded claim RENDERED LIVE on the distilled arm
D8: any planted claim not OBSERVED (seen < n) on the distilled arm
verbatim/raw: a verbatim-class case committed on the raw arm and NOT on the distilled arm
decision_rule.reported_not_thresholded: the knowledge-update current-state rate. D8 is explicit — the benchmark-side X set comes from the first published run, so no pass threshold is pre-set here (and no competing threshold is invented: the product gate lives at docs/product-success-eval.md)

epic_exit: Q3 exit bar — a published, sealed-benchmark measurement of the ask lane over a distilled + planted-supersession corpus

measurement.exclusion_rule: there is none. A case is never dropped to make the bar clean: a run that misses a pre-registered case, class, or arm is `inconclusive` (a subset run is not this measurement), and a case that failed to run in either arm is `inconclusive` too — an unmeasured case is never a pass and is never excluded. The only legitimate way to change the population is to re-register (a new commit of this file), BEFORE a run exists
falsifier: any superseded claim RENDERED LIVE to the reader on the gate arm falsifies the target
any planted superseded claim NOT OBSERVED on the gate arm falsifies the target (an unobserved claim is never a pass)
any verbatim-class case committed on the raw arm and LOST by the distilled arm falsifies the target — a KU win with a verbatim loss is a FAIL, not a trade

a corpus that plants no superseded claim, carries no verbatim case, or a raw arm that committed no verbatim case: the clauses would be satisfied vacuously, so such a run is `inconclusive` — a bar that cannot fail is not evidence
a corpus whose manifest does not verify, or whose hash is not this record's hash, makes every reading INCONCLUSIVE rather than green
a run graded by a judge / reader / pin / rubric / seed / arm set other than this record's is INCONCLUSIVE (`config_mismatch`), never a pass

metric.gate: superseded_live@<gate_arm> — per planted superseded claim: seen / rendered_live / flagged, attributed by the validity window
metric.no_regression: verbatim_no_regression — per verbatim case: raw.committed vs distilled.committed, and the list of cases the gate arm lost
metric.not_a_metric: the judge's semantic grade is never THRESHOLDED and never enters an absolute/comparability claim. It enters `metrics` as the per-arm `committed` count, which the report PRINTS as the knowledge-update rate (reported, no pass threshold) and reads as the paired within-run comparison — see `scoring.two_number_split`
metric.reported_not_thresholded: current_state@<arm> — the knowledge-update current-state rate; reported, never gated (D8)

measurement.not_claimed: no rate is claimed as a THRESHOLDED benchmark result and no absolute or cross-benchmark accuracy is claimed. The published claim is the two mechanical clauses above; the D8 rate is PRINTED as a reported number (§3 of the report) with no pass threshold attached to it, and the judge's reading is never presented as an absolute
measurement.pass_line: PASS iff the corpus verifies, the config matches this record, every pre-registered case ran in both arms, the VACUITY FLOORS did not fire (the scored corpus plants at least one superseded claim, carries at least one verbatim case, and the raw arm committed at least one — with none of them the clauses above would hold over a measurement that was never made, which is `inconclusive`, never a pass), `superseded_live@<gate_arm>.rendered_live == 0`, `superseded_live@<gate_arm>.seen == superseded_live@<gate_arm>.n`, and `verbatim_no_regression.regressions == []`. No other number is compared against any threshold

population.cases: every case this record's `corpus.cases` names, in BOTH arms inside ONE invocation
population.classes: every class `corpus.classes` names — the knowledge-update class IS the D8 gate and the verbatim class IS the no-regression half, so a run that covers one of them measured half a bar
population.denominator: cases per class per arm, and planted superseded claims for the D8 gate. The denominators are read from the corpus (`n_cases`, `seen`/`n`, `verbatim.n`), never assumed: a zero denominator is `inconclusive`, not a pass

measurement.target: the ask lane commits the CURRENT state on the knowledge-update class, and does not regress on the verbatim class, when the product's own reader answers over a distilled + planted-supersession corpus

reader.lane: run_ask_lane (the eval-only ask lane, EVAL-ONLY per #3849) — the product's own retrieval + render + reader path, not a re-implementation

reproduce.preregister: uv run python -m tools.longmem_eval.measure_ask_distilled preregister --out tests/eval/ask/preregistration.json

scoring.committed: the anscheck semantic judge built from THIS record's `judge.model_spec` (build_judge) grades the reader's answer against the SEALED gold answer, per case per arm, using the official TEMPLATE the sealed gold names (knowledge-update | single-session-user). ⛔ The TEMPLATE stays official; the JUDGE is this record's (`deepseek:deepseek-v4-pro`, pin `unpinned:`), never the official model — the pin is what says so
scoring.superseded_live: the assembled READER EVIDENCE is searched for the superseded claim's own text (ask_spotcheck._superseded_live_state): seen / rendered_live / flagged, attribution by the validity window so a raw turn is never mistaken for a distilled claim

two_number_split.d14_5085_shape: the write-path harness keeps the judged arm entirely out of `metrics` (`tests/eval/write_path/runner.py`); this benchmark cannot — its `committed` IS the judge's grade — so the equivalent guarantee is pre-registered explicitly instead: no THRESHOLD and no comparability claim for the judge-labelled rate (it IS printed as a REPORTED number, §3), and that half is only ever a paired comparison between the two arms of one run
two_number_split.judge_labelled: `committed` — whether the reader's answer matched the sealed gold — is the anscheck judge's grade. It feeds the knowledge-update rate (REPORTED, never thresholded) and the paired verbatim/raw comparison. Both arms are graded by the SAME judge inside ONE run, so a SYSTEMATIC judge bias cancels across the arms; a PERMISSIVE judge does not, which is why no THRESHOLD and no comparability claim are published for that rate (it is printed as a REPORTED number, §3) and why the judge is pinned
two_number_split.mechanical_and_authoritative: corpus verification (manifest + hashes) and the D8 supersession gate (seen / rendered_live / flagged, from the validity window) need NO judge and are AUTHORITATIVE
two_number_split.what_it_does_not_mean: the judge-free D8 half is NOT a makeshift substitute for a judge that was skipped — it is the bar's authoritative half, and the judge-labelled half is declared as such

scoring.verbatim_regression: for a verbatim-class case: raw.committed AND NOT distilled.committed

seed.note: the #9095 seeder's own defaults — the instrument is not re-tuned here

split: every case runs in BOTH arms inside ONE invocation (the D4 paired read: extend W2-b, never a parallel benchmark). No train/test split — the corpus is hand-authored and every case is scored, so there is nothing to fit.
